title: The deep's creatures wander the whole height
lede: Option C: three creatures (lanternfish, angler, dumbo), each roaming top to bottom. The school and the amphipod are gone. Each row is the same deep a minute of game time later.
head: d8204de4

items.title: Three creatures, the whole height
items.what: Shots a minute of game time apart: before, each keeps to its band; after, each wanders the whole water.
